roadmap.goal: Make the backend suite's calendar-day behaviour independent of the hour CI runs: one frozen, boundary-placed test instant shared by the integration host and TestToday, no ambient local clock in tests, and every production clock read going through TimeProvider / ILighthouseClock (RCA steps 1-6; step 7, zoning TestToday to Local, is out of scope).
out_of_scope: RCA step 7: set TestToday.Clock zone to TimeZoneInfo.Local (separate story)
Frontend and E2E suites (already pinned through localDate.ts)

Hosts not built on TestWebApplicationFactory (HealthCheckTestHost, TelemetryTestHost, ClusterSubstrateProbeRegistrationTest, ServiceProviderValidationTest, EncryptionBootstrapOrderTests, PostgresEmbedFactory) stay on real time
Lighthouse.Migrations.Postgres / Lighthouse.Migrations.Sqlite projects are not put under either ban
standing_rules: Every step leaves the filtered backend suite green on its own (dotnet test --filter "TestCategory!=Integration&TestCategory!=JiraIntegration&TestCategory!=LinearIntegration&TestCategory!=AdoIntegration&TestCategory!=ServiceNowIntegration"); dotnet build with zero warnings (TreatWarningsAsErrors, Directory.Build.props).
Comments: plain-language why only; never cite RCA step numbers, ADR numbers or 'root cause D'. Fix offending comments in touched files (several existing comments cite 'root cause D' / 'Bug #5567').
Consult docs/ci-learnings.md lines ~205-245 and ~698-705 (calendar days vs instants, Zurich pin) before each step.

BannedApiAnalyzers (steps 01-07 and 01-11): explicit Version on the PackageReference (no central package management in this repo), PrivateAssets=all, per-csproj AdditionalFiles only - never Directory.Build.props, so the migration projects are not banned. Pick one released version older than the NuGet min-release-age rule and use it in both steps.

steps.name: test(clock): pin the boundary instant as a named, asserted test fixture
steps.description: Introduce TestToday.FrozenNow = today's UTC date (taken once at test-host start) at 23:30Z, and a guard test proving that instant sits where the UTC day and the Zurich instance day disagree. Nothing consumes FrozenNow yet, so the suite is unchanged; the guard makes later moves of the instant or an un-pinned TZ fail loudly.
acceptance_criteria: TestToday exposes a FrozenNow instant whose UTC time of day is 23:30 and whose UTC date is the date the test process started.
The guard test passes when the process zone is Europe/Zurich (runsettings pin) under both summer (UTC+2) and winter (UTC+1) offsets: the instance-zone day of FrozenNow is the day after its UTC day.
The guard test fails with a message naming the zone if the process zone is UTC (the TZ pin was removed) or if FrozenNow is moved off the boundary.
Whole backend suite stays green; no existing test changes behaviour.
